name: building-construction-continuous-policy
description: #1039: an aggressive continuous-mode site policy (fatigue rest threshold 90) must not fragment a single place_building order into a chain of interrupt-walk-reclaim-restart cycles. Before ForceShiftRest.ts's isMidConstructionWork guard exists, the assigned employee is yanked off the driving_center site the instant fatigue crosses the policy's threshold, even mid-execution, and the crossing recurs every few ticks under a policy this aggressive — the construction never lands within this scenario's tick budget on the buggy code, instead of landing in roughly 20-25 ticks (BUILDING_CONSTRUCTION_BASE_DURATION_TICKS=15 plus a short walk from the staffed roster's spawn point, directly traced via `npm run console` on the plain default policy).

steps.description: Continuous mode with a high fatigue rest threshold (90, well above the default 60) makes the proactive shift-cycle rest fire every few ticks for a working employee — the aggressive policy setting that reliably reproduces #1039's fragmentation on the buggy code (empirically traced: the driving_center order never lands within 100 ticks under this policy before the fix). Driven through the Operations panel's own policy card, the way a player sets it: `set_policy` changes game state and is not on the setup allowlist, so this is a `player` step. The Continuous button is clicked before the threshold is typed — the click sets the panel's `policyDirty` flag, without which the next state sync overwrites the typed value back to the live threshold.

100 ticks is roughly 4-5x the ~20-25 ticks a clean, uninterrupted build takes (traced via `npm run console` under the plain default policy) — generous margin for the fixed behavior, but far below the multi-hundred-tick (or never-completing) fragmented behavior the bug produces under this aggressive policy.
